sections.title: Letter uve sound
paragraphs: The letter name is (uve) /ˈube/. Its main sound is heard in (verde) /ˈbeɾ.de/, which means green. This letter makes two sounds.

sections.title: How to say uve
paragraphs: For the first sound, close both lips firmly to stop the air. Then release the air gently with voice. For the second sound, bring both lips close together, but do not touch them. Let the air flow smoothly between your lips. Place a hand on your throat to feel it vibrate for both sounds.

sections.title: Spelling rules for uve
paragraphs: At the start of a word after a pause, or after a nasal consonant, it sounds like (verde) /ˈbeɾ.de/. It makes the same sound in (enviar) /emˈbjaɾ/. Between vowels, it softens to the sound in (uva) /ˈu.βa/. It also softens after non-nasal consonants, as in (curva) /ˈkuɾ.βa/.

sections.title: Common mistakes with uve
paragraphs: Do not touch your lower lip to your upper teeth like in English vine. Spanish never uses teeth for this letter. Keep your teeth completely out of the way, and use only your lips.
